note: Upstream terms of public robot datasets, each checked against a primary source. confidence: high = explicit data licence from the original authors; medium = umbrella or indirect statement (e.g. the Open X-Embodiment README); low = umbrella statement with an uncertain mapping. license 'not stated' means the original release states no data licence.
